in_hindi.name: जुमी
in_hindi.meaning: शुक्रवार का दिन मुसलमानों के लिए बहुत अच्छा दिन है
in_hindi.long_meaning: जुमी नाम शुक्रवार से लिया गया है जो मुसलमानों के लिए एक पवित्र दिन है। इस दिन मुसलमान लोग शुक्रवार की नमाज पढ़ने के लिए इकट्ठे होते हैं और एक दूसरे से मिलते हैं

in_pashto.name: جمعي
in_pashto.meaning: جمعې د ورځې ښکلی ورځ د مسلمانانو لپاره
in_pashto.long_meaning: جمعي نوم د جمعې د ورځې څخه اخیستل شوی دے، چې د مسلمانانو لپاره یوه سپیڅه ورځ ده. پدې ورځ مسلمانان د جمعې د نماز لپاره راټولېږي او له یو بل سره خبرې کوي

in_english.name: Jumu
in_english.meaning: Friday, a sacred day for Muslims, beautiful day for gathering
in_english.long_meaning: Jumu is derived from the Arabic word 'Jumu'ah', meaning Friday. In Islamic tradition, Friday is considered a sacred day when Muslims gather for congregational prayer. The name signifies a day of unity, spiritual rejuvenation, and community bonding. Historically, Fridays have been significant in Islamic culture for social and religious activities. The name Jumu symbolizes a connection to these values and traditions.

data.cultural_impact: In the Islamic context, Jumu is most notably associated with Jumu'ah or Friday Prayer, which is one of the obligatory collective or congregational Islamic prayers. Millions of Muslims all over the world come together in prayer halls, mosques, or open fields to perform this weekly communal act of worship. The practice of gathering for Jumuah prayer brings a sense of unity among Muslims, helping to strengthen brotherhood and foster a sense of belonging to the larger Islamic community.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, Jumu is an essential reminder for Muslims to recognize and value the importance of collective worship and the solidarity of the Islamic community. By gathering together in prayer, we are not only engaging in a sacred ritual, but also showing our commitment to upholding our religious and spiritual obligations as Muslims. Jumu symbolizes the unifying power of faith and the transcendent nature of spiritual connection, binding Muslims together in the pursuit of spiritual growth and enlightenment.
